content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Medical Officer: MBBS degree from institution recognized by Indian Medical Council. Live registration with Chhattisgarh Medical Council mandatory. Staff Nurse: B.Sc (Nursing) or P.B.B.Sc Nursing or General Nursing and Senior Midwifery training passed. Live registration with Chhattisgarh Nursing Council as Nurse mandatory. Pharmacist cum Administrative Staff: Diploma or Degree in Pharmacy from Pharmacy Council registered institution. Live registration with Chhattisgarh Pharmacy Council mandatory. Driver cum Support Staff: Minimum 8th class passed with valid heavy vehicle driving license. Minimum 1 year experience mandatory.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Minimum Age: 18 years Maximum Age: 70 years Age Relaxation: Driver cum Support Staff: max 40 years for local residents (5 years relaxation as per GAD order 18.01.2024); Staff Nurse and Pharmacist: max 64 years. Candidates should ensure that they fulfill the prescribed age criteria. Calculate your exact age using our Age Calculator before submitting your application to confirm your eligibility.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies announced by CMHO Surajpur?
faq.answer: CMHO Surajpur has announced a total of 4 vacancies for the posts of Medical Officer, Staff Nurse, Pharmacist cum Administrative Staff, and Driver cum Support Staff.

faq.question: Q2. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q3. What are the minimum and maximum age limits for the posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit is 18 years, and the maximum age limit is 70 years for all posts, with specific relaxations mentioned for certain categories.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Medical Officer post is Rs. 80,000 per month on a consolidated basis.

faq.question: Q5. Which educational qualifications are required for the Staff Nurse position?
faq.answer: For the Staff Nurse position, candidates need to have passed B.Sc (Nursing) or P.B.B.Sc Nursing or General Nursing and Senior Midwifery training, along with live registration with the Chhattisgarh Nursing Council.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. When is the walk-in interview scheduled for Medical Officer and Pharmacist cum Administrative Staff?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for Medical Officer and Pharmacist cum Administrative Staff is scheduled for 29th September 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable).

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process includes Document Verification, Merit List preparation, Walk-in Interview, and a Skill Test.
